about.title: Started by Mark Lange in 1973, still family owned.
text: Lanco was established in 1973 by Mark Lange, and we are a multi-generational family owned plumbing company.
Mark is retired now, and we are owned and operated by a brother and sister team, Max and Frances Lange.

Our office is in Dickinson, we have also had an office in League City, and we have served the surrounding area since 1973. We do not pay our plumbers on commission, so you are not sold things you do not need.
